title: wet-tile (from image)
description: Generated photograph made tileable and turned into a PBR set. Source: images/wet-tile.json (gemini-3.1-flash-image).

source.prompt: Flat orthographic top-down photograph of exactly 2 m x 2 m of a grimy square ceramic tile floor with 20 cm tiles (a 10 x 10 grid of tiles) and dark grout lines, slightly wet with dull diffuse reflections, dirt and wear. Filling the entire frame edge to edge. Muted desaturated Soviet industrial ruin, physically plausible colours. Even overcast diffuse daylight, no cast shadows, no directional light, no bright highlights, no vignette, no lighting gradient, no perspective, no objects, no text, no watermark. Uniform exposure across the whole image.
